title: fix(app-crm): hide the Pipeline nav entry from a member who cannot read opportunities

_Requested by **Bill** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg?thread=cmsg_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wgC1o88pHYeo2G8hvcGVV1s1)_
Fixes #27735
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none
Ruling-ref: 6512784198

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：CRM 侧栏的 Pipeline 入口加了一个显示条件 `current_user.can('crm_opportunity', 'read')`，读不到商机的成员看不到它；仪表盘本身、权限集和能力都不动。
- 为什么改：没有销售权限集的成员原来侧栏有 Pipeline，点进去六个组件全被拒。按裁决 G 用「藏」而不是「拒」：首版声明能力的做法会让 CRM 不能非托管安装，种子管理员也会被拒。
- 风险与回滚：只改示例的一个导航项和一个测试文件。拒绝仍由数据集查询的 403 负责，未变；种子管理员和销售用户照旧能看到。回滚就是 revert。
- 先看：`examples/app-crm/src/apps/crm.app.ts`（一行）、`examples/app-crm/test/pipeline-audience.test.ts`。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/example-crm exec vitest run test/pipeline-audience.test.ts`，预期 2 个用例全绿。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

Per ruling 6512784198 (letter G, which amends the mechanism of #27491 ruling 6508997538 item 5):

- `examples/app-crm/src/apps/crm.app.ts`: `nav_pipeline_dashboard` gains `visible: "current_user.can('crm_opportunity', 'read')"`. Nothing else on the entry changes. `opportunity_metrics`, the dataset every Pipeline widget reads, is bound to `crm_opportunity`.
- The first revision's capability approach is fully reverted: no `crm.view_pipeline` declaration, no stack `capabilities`, no `systemPermissions` on `crm_sales_user`, and no `requiredPermissions` on `pipeline_dashboard` or its nav entry. The branch diff against `main` is the two files listed here.

`visible` hides and refuses nothing (ADR-0066 D4). The refusal stays the dataset query's 403 for a caller who cannot read `crm_opportunity`, unchanged. The server's meta read gate does not judge `visible`, so the seeded administrator's reads of the dashboard (the dogfood's managed-install lock control) are untouched, and the package stays installable unmanaged.

Acceptance (as amended by the ruling): a member who cannot read `crm_opportunity` sees no Pipeline entry in the CRM sidebar; a sales user and the seeded administrator see it as today; a direct link for the refused member shows the #27491 no-access panel (PR #27777), not a blank.

## Tests

`examples/app-crm/test/pipeline-audience.test.ts` (new, 2 cases), read off the parsed stack:

- the Pipeline nav entry carries a CEL `visible` of the form `current_user.can(OBJECT, 'read')` (the stack parse normalises the authored string to `{ dialect: 'cel', source }`);
- OBJECT equals the `object` of the dataset that every `pipeline_dashboard` widget reads, derived from the definitions, not hard-coded.

Ablation: `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` replacing `crm_opportunity` with `crm_account` in the predicate (anchor hit 1) turns the second case red (`expected [ 'crm_opportunity' ] to deeply equal [ 'crm_account' ]`), restored to the HEAD blob with `git diff HEAD` empty.

## Acceptance notes

- What the tests do not run: the console's nav guard that evaluates `current_user.can` (`ui/packages/app-shell`, objectui#4421). The example has no renderer harness; the pins cover the predicate's shape and its object.
- No changeset: `@objectstack/example-crm` is `private: true`; labelled `skip-changeset`.
- The first revision (head `87e10674`) measured why a declared capability does not fit here: `install-local-unmanaged-mode.dogfood.test.ts` went 11 failed / 9 passed (422 `UNMANAGED_INSTALL_UNCOPYABLE` on the stack's `capabilities`, and 403 `audience-permission` for the seeded administrator), against 20/20 at the merge-base. Recorded in the ruling.

- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --ran`: 39 derived, 38 run, 1 NOT-MEASURED (`check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, exit 3 PREREQUISITE NOT MET: needs every package's dist; CI's). Three families first answered from a mid-build tree and were re-run after the build settled: `check:dts-closure` (exit 1 naming `@objectstack/runtime` / `service-automation` while the dogfood closure was rebuilding, then `driver-odata`, new on `main`, unlinked until `pnpm install`) exit 0; `check:i18n-coverage` exit 0 ("OK (14 config(s), 527 baselined untranslated string(s), none new)"); `check:type-check-debt` exit 0 ("0 raw tsc error(s) total, none above its recorded number").
